title: Measure output rows
description: The rows that one measuring command writes to the path in GATE_OUTPUT: one JSON array, one row per function. crap-score exits 2 and names the measure and the field when the file is not such an array or a row lacks one of the six fields (validation-rules.md BR-130). A row whose value breaks this schema, such as coverage_pct 120, is in the wrong shape and gives exit 2 as well. A code file that the command cannot parse gets one parse error row instead (DEC-34). JSON Schema cannot compare two fields, so BR-130 adds one more wrong shape: a function row whose start_line is above its end_line gives exit 2 (DEC-42).

file.description: Path relative to the repository root, also for a file without a file ending.

function.description: The qualified name of the function, such as Parser.parse for the method parse of the class Parser (DEC-12). Register rows use the same name.

end_line.description: Last line of the function. crap-score counts the function as changed when a changed line lies between start_line and end_line (BR-131). It is at or above start_line; a row with start_line above end_line is a wrong shape (DEC-42).

coverage_pct.description: Share of the function that the tests cover, from 0 to 100.

file.description: The code file that the measuring command cannot parse.

parse_error.description: The message of the parser. crap-score fails the row with exit 1 and names the file (DEC-34).
